heading: Choose your training format
introduction: Hands-on practice makes the difference when introducing Tekla Structures into your company’s real project work.

formats.title: Essentials · minimum practice
paragraphs: The shortest and most affordable format, well suited to individual engineers and students working with a very limited budget.
Also recommended when you need to learn a specific tool or a narrowly defined topic without covering the full course programme.
Practice is kept to a minimum: focused demonstrations and short exercises help you get started quickly.
formats.enquiry: 2 days of compact training with minimum practice, covering the essentials or specific topics agreed with your instructor.

formats.title: In-depth training · more practice
paragraphs: Recommended for companies that need to train their engineers even though training was not planned and no dedicated budget was set aside.

Five days allow a more thorough study of your chosen course, with substantially more guided practice, repetition and instructor feedback than the 2-day option. A practical choice when the full 10-day training and implementation programme is beyond the available budget.
formats.enquiry: 5 days of in-depth training with substantially more guided practice than the 2-day format.

formats.title: Training + your own pilot project
formats.split: 5 days of training + 5 days of guided project work
paragraphs: Designed for a full rollout of Tekla Structures in an engineering or detailing department. Your team works on a real project of your own and produces project drawings and other documentation with your instructor’s guidance.
The longer format allows topics to be explored in greater depth, with substantially more hands-on practice and time to resolve issues on your first project.
During the five-day pilot project, your instructor can also give additional lessons on specific topics relevant to your work, tailoring the training to your team’s needs.
formats.popularity: Around 95% of our clients choose training with a pilot project.
formats.enquiry: 5 days of in-depth training + 5 days on the customer’s own pilot project, producing project documentation with instructor support and additional targeted lessons as needed.
